watch.summary: A streamer repeatedly insists today is a happy day while calmly watching his in-game egg roll right past the target pad.

beats.what: Streamer declares he won't be pissed and that today is a happy day.
The egg rolls up the ramp towards the landing pad.
The egg misses the pad and rolls off into the grass.
Streamer calmly continues his positive mantra, saying 'just joy and bliss'.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedic tension comes from the contrast between the streamer forcing a calm, happy attitude and the quietly frustrating game failure happening on screen.
